title: Marico (Saffola Honey) — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
The sources indicate that Marico's Saffola brand has undergone a significant transformation from a heart-health cooking oil to a multi-category preventive wellness brand. Saffola Honey, a new venture by Marico, symbolizes the brand's expansion into the honey segment, aiming to blend urban sophistication with the rejuvenating freshness of nature. The sources also mention a CGI-driven unveiling of Saffola Honey's active packaging, emphasizing the brand's commitment to nature and wellness. However, there is some debate on whether this expansion into honey dilutes the brand's equity, with opinions divided on the strategic merits of this move.

How Marico transformed Saffola from a heart-health edible oil into one of India’s most trusted preventive wellness brands across categories.

Marico's Saffola Honey pricing model focuses on distribution improvements in general trade, with decent profitability and not competing on price. The company aims to leverage its strong brand distribution and quality, rather than undercutting competitors on price. Saffola Honey was restaged with two variants: Saffola Honey Active and Saffola Honey Gold, emphasizing quality through Sundarban Forest Honey and Kashmir Honey. The company's strategy includes maintaining a healthy product profile and focusing on quality, packaging, and brand distribution.

In its key segments, Parachute revenue grew 59% year-over-year despite a 3% volume decline, while Saffola Oil saw 19% revenue growth with flat volume. Value-added Hair Oils revenue increased by 16%, led by double-digit volume growth in premium offerings.

The international business maintained strong momentum with 19% revenue growth, driven by strong performance in Bangladesh and MENA regions, while Vietnam showed gradual recovery.

Marico's key differentiators for Saffola compared to other FMCG & Consumer Goods companies include its positioning as a premium, heart-healthy oil in the health-conscious segment, leveraging strong content marketing and awareness campaigns to educate consumers about healthy living. The brand has maintained its identity as a healthy oil good for heart and people with cholesterol, creating a niche in the Super Premium Refined Edible Oil category. Saffola has evolved from a therapeutic space to a preventive one, targeting people who want to adopt a healthier way of life, offering better-for-you alternatives and expanding into foods as part of its diversification strategy.
